summary: Picks up files from an FTP, FTPS or SFTP server on a schedule, leaving files still being written for the next run.

properties.name: Port
properties.description: Server port. If empty, the protocol's default port is used.

properties.name: Password
properties.description: Account password, or the private key passphrase when using SFTP with a private key.

properties.name: TargetPath
properties.description: Remote directory to change into before listing/downloading files.

properties.name: BatchSize
properties.description: Maximum number of files to fetch per polling batch.

properties.name: ResponseEncoding
properties.description: Encoding used to decode file contents (e.g. utf8).

properties.name: DeleteMovesFileTo
properties.description: Folder to move a file to after it's received. If empty, the file is deleted instead.

properties.name: Protocol
properties.description: Transfer protocol to use (sftp or ftp).

properties.name: CheckFileExistence
properties.description: Whether to verify the file still exists before attempting to delete or move it after receiving.

properties.name: PrivateKey
properties.description: Private key used for SFTP authentication instead of a password.

properties.name: HostKeyFingerprint
properties.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the SFTP server's host key, as 'ssh-keygen -lf' prints it (SHA256:...). When set, a server presenting any other key is refused before credentials are sent.

properties.name: MinimumFileAgeSeconds
properties.description: Seconds a file must have gone unchanged before it is taken, so one still being uploaded is left for the next run. 0 takes every file listed.
